title: App Studio 改版（follow-up of 1-5）：只读包的锁和「待发布」给键盘和读屏用户说明原因
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbL6Nn3scsU8yvLyU4

Filing gate: ③ · Source: seat 5's contract review 7202356468 on PR #37579 (#37456), nit N5, which the seat recommended as a card. Sub-issue of #37456.
Grade: area:ux · Feature · p3 · evidence: the switcher's lock on a read-only package and the Pending door's read-only state show their reason only on hover, if at all. Keyboard and assistive-tech users get no reason.
Reader: area `ux-37424`, or the next holder of area:ux.

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：用键盘或读屏的人，在只读软件包上也能听到/看到「为什么不能改、不能发布」。
- 为什么：现在原因只在鼠标悬停时出现。
- 需要你做的：无。

## What

- Give the lock in `StudioPackageSwitcher` / `StudioTopLeft` an accessible name that carries the read-only reason, reusing `engine.studio.pkg.readonlyHint`.
- Give the read-only Pending / publish door an `aria-describedby` with the same reason.

## Acceptance

- The reason is announced in tests (role and name queries), with an ablation that goes red. Wait until PR #37579 merges.
